subtitulo: The no that never says no
introPt: A soft yes turns out to be a no, and the visitor reads it in time.
cenario: A request that quietly will not happen.

dialogo.pt: Yes, I will bring it right now.

dialogo.es: Uy, hoy va a estar difícil.
dialogo.pt: Ooh, today is going to be difficult.

dialogo.es: No se preocupe, así está bien.
dialogo.pt: Do not worry, it is fine.

perguntas.pergunta: Why is a direct no often avoided?
opcoes: Because it can read as rejecting the person
perguntas.explica: Deferral keeps the relationship and embarrasses nobody.

perguntas.pergunta: What does va a estar difícil usually mean?
opcoes: It will take effort but happen
perguntas.explica: The no delivered so nobody had to say it.

perguntas.pergunta: How do you turn a soft yes into information?
perguntas.explica: A real yes produces a time; a soft no produces another deferral.

perguntas.pergunta: Someone stands closer than you expect. What does stepping back signal?
perguntas.explica: Distance is legible here; keep the warmth in your face.

perguntas.pergunta: How does time to go usually arrive?
opcoes: As people standing up or talk thinning
perguntas.explica: Naming it yourself first is the courteous move.
